segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Good morning. World Tours. My name is Jamie. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: Good morning. I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA. Could you send me a brochure?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Of course. Could you I have your name please?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: Andrea Brown.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Thank you. And your address?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: 24, Ardleigh Road. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Can you spell that?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: A-R-D-L-E-I-G-H Road.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Postcode?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: BH5 2OP

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Thanks. And can I have your phone number?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: Is a mobile alright?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Fine.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Thank you. And can I ask you where you heard about World Tours? From a friend? Or did you see an advert somewhere?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: No, I read about you in the newspaper. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: OK, I’ll get the brochures in the post to you but can I give you some information over the phone. What kinds of things do you want to do on your holiday?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: I’m interested in going to California with my family. I’ve got two children and we want to hire a car.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: OK. We have a couple of self-drive tours there visiting different places of interest in California. The first one begins in Los Angeles and there’s plenty of time to visit some of the theme [[ ]] parks there.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: That’s something on my children’s list so I’d want to include that.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Good. Then you drive to San Francisco. From San Francisco you can drive to Yosemite Park where you spend a couple of nights. You can choose to stay in a lodge or on the campsite.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: I don’t like the idea of staying in a tent [[ ]] . It’d be too hot.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Right. And the tour ends in Las Vegas.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: The other trip we can arrange is slightly different. It starts in San Francisco. Then you drive south to Cambria.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: Someone told me there’s a really nice castle [[ ]] near Cambria. Will we go near that?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Hearst Castle is on that road so you could stop there.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: Good. I’d like to do that. Does this trip also go into the desert?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: No, it continues to Santa Monica where most people like to stop and do some shopping.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: We have enough of that at home so that doesn’t interest us.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: OK. Well you could go straight on to San Diego.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: That’s good for beaches isn’t it? [[ ]]

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: That’s right, that’s a good place to relax and your children might like to visit the zoo before flying home.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: I don’t think so. We want some time for sunbathing and swimming. ————————–

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: So how many days are the trips and how much do they cost?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: The first one I told you about is a self-drive tour through California which lasts twelve days and covers 2,020 [[ ]] kilometres. The shortest journey is 206 km and the longest is 632 kilometres. The cost is £525 per person. That includes accommodation, car rental and a flight [[ ]] but no meals.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: OK. And the other trip?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: That lasts nine days but you spend only three days on the road. You cover about 980 kilometres altogether.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: So is that cheaper then?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: Yes, it’s almost a hundred pounds cheaper. It’s £429 [[ ]] per person, which is a good deal.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: So that covers accommodation and car hire. What about flights?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: They aren’t included. But these hotels offer dinner [[ ]] in the price.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: OK. Well, thank you very much. I’ll be in touch when I’ve had a chance to look at the brochure.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.en: I’m pleased to help. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.en: Goodbye.
